Title: Reduce dataflow execution time with cluster reuse public preview in Azure Data Factory

Body.Content:
Data Flows are ADF’s low-code visual data transformation tool that executes at scale with just-in-time Spark compute. Now, you can keep the cluster environment available for your data flows activities, resulting in super-fast startup times.

Learn more.
